`-- I/O-thread stack: CallbackData.data (NOT an Exec field)

        |-- process watcher / start / exited
        |   `-- processExitCommon -> surface_mailbox(.child_exited)
        |-- write_stream / write_queue / write_pool
        |   `-- Each Write owns stable request + buffer; completion recycles
        |-- termios_timer + cached terminal-driver mode
        `-- read_thread / quit pipe / PTY fd
            |-- POSIX io-reader stack
            |   |-- Pipeline: rotating buffers + lengths + head/tail/count
            |   |   `-- mutex / batch_ready / slot_free / idle pipe
            |   |-- io-gather -> read/poll PTY; fill pipeline; observe quit
            |   `-- consume batch -> Termio.processOutput; yieldToDemand
            |       `-- Reader joins gather thread before returning
            `-- Windows: blocking read -> processOutput; yieldToDemand
